bio: Foodies are in seventh heaven in this elegant and endearing villa. The infectious friendly home-from-home vibe is the work of your cheerful hostess and her team. The traditional menu, which features the occasional modern tribute, reveals the hallmark of a seasoned chef, who is equally at ease when crafting fresh, acidic flavours as with a textbook tournedos Rossini or kidneys in a mustard sauce. The well-padded menu reads like an ode to soul-warming old-school cuisine in all its timeless, generous glory....
